card.name: Commas and linking words in side-effect lists
card.fires_on: Commas and small linking words such as "and" right after a medical condition in a list of adverse effects, especially "Leukopenia, Neutropenia" before "Agranulocytosis" and skin reaction lists.

modes.label: Comma in condition list
modes.description: A comma following a listed adverse condition, before the next one.

modes.label: And/with/by after condition
modes.description: A linking word following the condition terms or in nearby warning text.

card.plain: It fires on the commas and "and" inside lists of side effects, mainly blood-count and skin reaction lists.
